title: com.pqt.pos.sale.line data
description: One line of a bill (X1, milestone B1). Money is integer minor units (paise for INR). Allow-listed fields only: no customer identity, card numbers or free text (ADR-033).

billRef.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the bill number with the store's key (ADR-033); never the real number.

revision.description: 0 for the first version of the bill; consumers take the highest revision per bill.

sku.description: The billing system's item code (business data, not personal).

qtyMilli.description: Quantity in thousandths of `unit` (1 piece = 1000; 0.5 kg = 500). Negative for a returned item on the same bill.

amountMinor.description: Line amount after line discounts, including tax, in minor units. Negative for a returned item or a bill-level discount line.

taxMinor.description: Tax included in amountMinor, in minor units.
